SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

REPORT

（印：HEADQUARTERS CRIME BRANCH
File No. ________
No. 10/39 Station,
Date January 13th 1939.）

Subject ASSISTANCE RENDERED TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE.

Made by D.S.I. KONOVALOFF Forwarded by C.D.I. GRUBB.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTER
No. S. B. D. 297/
Date ________）

Sir,

Acting on instructions received from C.D.I. Grubb,
officer i/c C.I., D.S.I. Soong Ping Tsung and the under-
signed rendered the necessary assistance to the Japanese
Gendarmerie who requested to arrest one named Chang Su
Pao (張少寶), the alleged section commander of the
Mobile Unit operating in the Wusih region.

At 6.30 a.m. the 13.1.39 Warrant Officer H. Shimowaturi
of the Japanese Gendarmerie, J.D.S. Mitsushima of the S.P.
Office and the above mentioned detectives of C.I. office,
visited a house No. 13, Lane 52, Mohawk Road, but no such
a person by the name of Chang Su Pao was found on the
premises, and no person was taken into custody.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

P. Konovaloff
D. S. I.

FILED. C. (Special Branch).

Punk 13/1）

（批：S.L.
(Sp. Br.)）

报告

（印：总部刑事侦缉处
档案号 ________
第10/39号分局，
日期 1939年1月13日。）

事由 向日本宪兵队提供协助。

由 副督察长 科诺瓦洛夫 (KONOVALOFF) 呈报 经 首席副督察长 格鲁布 (GRUBB) 转呈。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
登记簿
编号 S. B. D. 297/
日期 ________）

先生：

奉首席副督察长格鲁布之命，刑事侦缉处负责警官、副督察长宋秉忠 (Soong Ping Tsung) 及卑职向日本宪兵队提供了必要协助。该宪兵队请求逮捕一名名为张少宝 (Chang Su Pao) 的男子，据称其为在无锡地区活动的流动部队分队长。

1939年1月13日上午6时30分，日本宪兵队准尉下渡利 (H. Shimowaturi)、特别警察办公室的三岛 (J.D.S. Mitsushima) 以及上述刑事侦缉处的侦探，前往莫霍克路 (Mohawk Road) 52弄13号的一处住宅，但在该处并未发现名为张少宝之人，亦未拘捕任何人。

此致
敬礼

P. 科诺瓦洛夫 (Konovaloff)
副督察长

已归档。C. (特务科)。

（批：Dr/
庞克 13/1）

（批：S.L.
(特务科)）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No. ____ POLICE REGISTRY
S. B. D. Station,
Date March 6, 1939.
HEADQUARTERS,

Subject VISIT PAID BY JAPANESE GENDARMERIE TO BRIDGE HOUSE.

Made by D. I. I. Konovaloff Forwarded by I. Grubb

Sir,

At 7 p.m. on the 5th March, Sergt. Major T. Kawasaki and four other members Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters, Bridge House, came to Central Crime Branch O.I. and requested assistance to search premises situated at a house No. 7, Lane 170, off Bubbling Well Road.

Sergt. Major T. Kawasaki stated that according to the information obtained by them about one hundred hand grenades are being kept on the premises by a member of a Mobile Unit.

Acting on instruction of I. Grubb, O/I C.I., the necessary assistance was rendered by D.I. Tsoung, D.I. 104, J. A. S. Yonphera, C. Office and the undersigned.

The ground floor of the premises in question was found to be occupied by the Tri Star (三星) Chinese Medicine Company. A room situated on the first floor, occupied by one named Lung Tsch Kong (龍祖康), a sole owner of the above concern, was thoroughly searched, nothing of an incriminating nature was found therein.

At the request of Sergt. Major Kawasaki an adjoining room, occupants of which were absent at the time, was searched, but, likewise, with negative result; entry into this room was effected by breaking through canvas affixed above the wooden partition.

However, on being requested by Sergt. Major Kawasaki, the occupant of the first searched room, Lung Tsch Kong, was taken to C.I. offices for the purpose of questioning.

（左侧手写批注：accs. / 302 / P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) / S/ / 16/3）

1939年3月6日

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

档案号 ____ 警务登记簿
S. B. D. 分局，
日期 1939年3月6日。
总部，

事由 日本宪兵队访问百老汇大厦 (Bridge House)。

由 督察员 科诺瓦洛夫 (Konovaloff) 呈报 经 I. 格鲁布 (Grubb) 转呈

先生：

3月5日晚7时，日本宪兵队总部（驻百老汇大厦）的军曹长 T. 川崎 (T. Kawasaki) 及其他四名成员来到中央刑事侦缉处情报股，请求协助搜查位于静安寺路 (Bubbling Well Road) 旁170弄7号的一处房产。

军曹长 T. 川崎称，根据他们获得的情报，一名流动部队成员在该处藏有约一百枚手榴弹。

遵照刑事侦缉处负责警官 I. 格鲁布的指示，由邹督察 (D.I. Tsoung)、104号分局督察 J. A. S. Yonphera、C. 办公室人员及卑职提供了必要协助。

经查，该房产的一楼由三星 (Tri Star) 中药公司占用。对位于二楼、由上述商号独资业主龙祖康 (Lung Tsch Kong) 占用的一个房间进行了彻底搜查，未发现任何具有罪证性质的物品。

应军曹长川崎的要求，对隔壁一个当时无人居住的房间也进行了搜查，同样一无所获；进入该房间是通过打破木隔断上方固定的帆布实现的。

然而，应军曹长川崎的要求，第一个被搜查房间的 occupant 龙祖康被带往刑事侦缉处办公室接受讯问。

（左侧手写批注：accs. / 302 / P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) / S/ / 16/3）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C.l. Misc. File No. 23/39
No. S. A. D.
H. C. B. Station,
Date March 6, 1939

REPORT

Subject FURTHER TO ASSIST NOE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE HEADQUARTERS,
BRIDGE HOUSE.

Made by D.S.I. Konovaloff Forwarded by C.D.I. Grubb

Sir,

I beg to report that from interrogation of Zung Tsoh Kong ( **〔此处转录不清〕** ), the undersigned has disclosed the following facts in connection with this case.

Whilst questioned by the undersigned in the offices of C.l., H.Q.C.B., Zung Tsoh Kong stated that prior to the visit of the police party on the previous date, he was called upon twice by three unknown Chinese (one of them called twice). These men first ascertained his name, and on the second visit, they accused him of being a member of a mobile unit.

Although no monetary question was raised by these three men, they warned Zung Tsoh Kong that the Japanese Military Police might come to his home and place him under arrest, and at the same time advised him to disappear in order to avoid ill consequences.

On obtaining this information, the undersigned questioned Sgt. Major Kawasaki whether or not any of their agents had visited and questioned Zung Tsoh Kong on the subject.

An interpreter, Formosan (name unknown) employed by the Japanese Gendarmerie Hdqrs., who also took part in the raid, then admitted that the three male Chinese, whom Zung Tsoh Kong referred to, were his agents, who had made the visit on his instructions.

However, neither Sgt. Major Kawasaki nor the interpreter offered any explanation for doing so.

Yours obediently,

D. S. I.

FM. 2

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
C.l. 杂项档案号 23/39
编号 S. A. D.
H. C. B. 分局，
日期 1939年3月6日

报告

事由 关于进一步协助日本宪兵队总部（驻百老汇大厦）事宜。

由 副督察长 科诺瓦洛夫 (Konovaloff) 呈报 经 首席副督察长 格鲁布 (Grubb) 转呈

先生：

卑职谨此报告，通过对宗佐康 (Zung Tsoh Kong)（ **〔此处转录不清〕** ）的讯问，卑职揭示了与本案有关的以下事实。

在总部刑事侦缉处刑事侦缉股办公室接受卑职讯问时，宗佐康陈述，在前一日警方探访之前，曾有三位不知名的中国人（其中一人来了两次）找过他两次。这些人首先查明了他的姓名，在第二次来访时，指责他是流动部队的成员。

虽然这三人未提及金钱问题，但他们警告宗佐康，日本军事警察可能会到他家将他逮捕，同时建议他躲藏起来以避免不良后果。

获得此信息后，卑职询问川崎 (Kawasaki) 军曹长，是否有任何其手下特工就此事拜访并讯问过宗佐康。

随后，一名受雇于日本宪兵队总部、同时也参与了此次突击行动的中国台湾籍（福尔摩沙）翻译（姓名不详）承认，宗佐康所指的那三名中国男子是他的特工，是奉其指令前去拜访的。

然而，川崎军曹长和该翻译均未对此行为作出任何解释。

此致
敬礼

副督察长

FORM 40
G. S.C.M 1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of ZUNG TSOH KONG ( ____ ), 22, Married,
native of Ningpo taken by me C.D.S. 104,
at C.1 on the 5. 3. 39 and interpreted by Z. P. Tsaung.

I am the proprietor of Tai Woo Foong Kyi Medicine Coy.
situated at House 7, Lane 479, Honan Road.
At about 5 p.m. 4.3.39 two strangers, speaking Ningpo
dialect, came to my home and one of them asked who was called
Zung Tsoh Kong, whereupon I replied I was the man. The same
person then asked me whether I have received a letter the
previous day. I answered in the negative. The two visitors
commenced to whisper to each other, and I told them that they
must have made a mistake, as I did not know them at all. They
admitted that they were wrong, and left the premises. At about
6 p.m. the same day, two visitors, one of whom came on the
previous occasion, arrived at my shop. The man who also came on
the first occasion asked me whether I had any enemies, to which
I replied in the negative. He, however, persisted in his belief
that I had some enemies, stating that they were secret agents of
the Japanese gendarmerie at Hongkew, and had learned that some-
one had accused me of being a member of a mobile unit, for which
I might be taken into custody the next day. He further said that
they let me know this, because we were all natives of Ningpo and
I told them that I was not concerned in guerilla activities. They
then stated that it would not mean anything even if someone came
to make enquiries on the next day and that it would be alright
since I am not a member of a mobile unit. They left me soon
afterwards. At the time of the Police raid at my house, this
evening, one of the men who came to warn me beforehand was also
amongst the party.

Sgd.& cross-marked by ZUNG TSOH KONG.

表格 40
G. S.C.M 1-38

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。

以下为宗佐康 (ZUNG TSOH KONG)（ ____ ），22岁，已婚，宁波籍，于1939年3月5日在刑事侦缉股由我（刑事侦缉股104号）录取，并由 Z. P. Tsaung 翻译的供词。

我是位于河南路479弄7号的泰和丰记 (Tai Woo Foong Kyi) 药行的业主。
1939年3月4日下午5时许，两名讲宁波话的陌生人来到我家，其中一人询问谁是宗佐康，我回答我就是。同一个人接着问我前一天是否收到一封信。我回答没有。这两名访客开始互相耳语，我告诉他们肯定搞错了，因为我根本不认识他们。他们承认弄错了，便离开了该处。当天傍晚6时许，又有两名访客来到我的店铺，其中一人是上次来过的那位。第一次也来过的那位男子问我是否有仇家，我回答没有。然而，他坚持认为我有仇家，声称他们是虹口日本宪兵队的秘密特工，得知有人指控我是流动部队成员，因此我第二天可能会被拘留。他还说，他们之所以告诉我这些，是因为我们都是宁波同乡，且我告诉他们我并不参与游击活动。他们随后表示，即使第二天有人来查询也没什么大不了的，既然我不是流动部队成员，那就没事了。不久后他们便离开了。今晚警察搜查我家时，事先来警告我的那群人中的一人也在搜查队伍中。

由 宗佐康 签名并画押。
